item.name: Food_Surface_Sanitizer
item.description: PURELL Foodservice Surface Sanitizer, 32 fl oz spray bottle, product 3341-06, EPA registration 84150-3.
item.readyBeforeUse: The bottle contains sanitizer, sprays, and is not expired.
item.readyForNextPerson: The bottle is closed, contains sanitizer, and is stored away from heat or flame.
item.ifNotReady: Do not substitute an unlabeled product. Ask the Food Lead for a replacement.

problem.condition: The bottle is near heat or open flame.
problem.response: Move it to its cool storage place before use; the product is combustible.
